title: PCA Exam Strategy & Keyword Elimination — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates Exam Distractor Trap Detection: identifies subtle trick phrases ('least cost', 'RTO = 0', 'global external consistency') that disqualify seemingly correct answers.
routing_rationale: Recognizing exam trap phrasing prevents candidates from selecting technically functional but exam-incorrect distractor answers.

nodes.label: Modifier: 'Most cost-effective'
nodes.detail: Question asks for the most cost-effective backup storage for 7-year legal compliance.

nodes.label: Distractor: Standard Cloud Storage
nodes.detail: Technically stores backups, but costs 16x more than Archive class.

nodes.label: Correct: Archive Cloud Storage
nodes.detail: Lowest-cost storage class designed specifically for data accessed less than once a year.

nodes.label: Add: Retention Policy (Bucket Lock)
nodes.detail: Satisfies the 7-year regulatory retention requirement without operational overhead.

steps.title: Cost Modifier Analysis
steps.action: Recognizes 'most cost-effective' requires evaluating storage pricing per gigabyte.
steps.why_traversal: Archive class ($0.0012) beats Standard ($0.020) and Nearline ($0.010).

steps.title: Regulatory Requirement Alignment
steps.action: Bucket Lock satisfies legal hold requirement cleanly.
steps.why_traversal: Delivers comprehensive answer satisfying all question clauses.

scenarios.label: Selected Archive Storage for Daily Active Backups
scenarios.root_cause: Workload required daily backup restoration tests; Archive retrieval fees made it more expensive than Standard.
scenarios.diverted_path: Retrieval fees exceeded storage savings by 500%.
scenarios.recovery: Only select Archive storage when data access frequency is strictly once a year or less.
